job.location: Raleigh, North Carolina, full-time and in person
job.rawJd: About Planning Pod. Planning Pod is the operating system for the events industry. More than 1,200 event venues and planners run their bookings, clients, contracts, payments, and day-to-day operations on our platform. We have a proven product, a loyal customer base, and a profitable business. We are now building an AI-native version of Planning Pod, designed from the ground up around what large language models make possible. Backed by our own cash flow and by Kirra Capital, we have the speed and ambition of a startup paired with an existing customer base, deep domain knowledge, and the runway to build the right product. We plan to roll this new platform out to our existing customers over the next 6 months. About the Role. This entry-level role will gather product requirements, write documentation, interview customers, and organize the team to make sure we are all moving in one direction. You will work directly with our CTO and alongside a small, hand-picked engineering team dedicated to the new platform. You will learn what it takes to work in a high-performing software team from the inside. No prior full-time work experience is required. Our ideal candidate has excellent organization and writing skills, is an effective communicator, is comfortable talking to customers, and is willing to try new things. You will own entire processes and products from start to finish. Who Should Apply. This role is based in our Raleigh, NC office, full-time, in-person. We are building together, in the same room, and that matters to us. Do not apply unless you are willing and excited to come to the office every day you are working. We expect to move quickly and make mistakes, and you should be willing to take that same perspective, staying focused on results instead of process. We do not want egos. We take our work seriously but not ourselves. We believe work should be fun, engaging, and a key part of your life. Do not apply if you are looking for a paycheck or an easy 9-to-5. This role is for people who want to build something impactful and are willing to invest their time and energy into it. If you have thought about joining McKinsey, Booz, or a big tech rotational program but are not excited about the mission or culture, you might be a perfect fit for us. Our Requirements. 0-2 years of product development or related experience (new grads welcome). Excellent writing and verbal communication skills. Strong critical reasoning and attention to detail. Detailed organization and follow-through. An excellent GPA or proven success in an entry-level capacity. Driven, high-energy, positive, and optimistic. Based in Raleigh, NC (or willing to relocate) and excited to work in-person, full-time, with the team. Your Responsibilities. Interview customers, run product demos, and turn call notes into structured product insights. Write clear, professional product documentation, both internal and customer-facing. Write product requirements and user stories that leave nothing ambiguous for engineering. Organize and run our Jira and agile development processes. Answer developer and customer questions about new features. Investigate and troubleshoot bugs surfaced by customers and internal teams. Plan and coordinate product releases, including the rollout to our existing 1,200+ customers. Conduct product walkthroughs, demos, and webinars for customers and prospects. Some limited travel may be required. Why Planning Pod. You will help launch a new AI-native platform to 1,200+ existing paying customers. You will work directly with the CTO, the engineering team, and the CEO from day one. Real end-to-end ownership from your first week. Startup pace with the backing of a profitable business and Kirra Capital as an investor. Competitive salary plus performance incentives. Healthcare, 401K match, and 15 vacation days growing to 20 with tenure. A clear path to grow into product management as the team and platform scale. Pay: $55,000.00-$70,000.00 per year. Benefits: 401(k), 401(k) matching, dental insurance, health insurance, health savings account, paid time off, and vision insurance. Work Location: In person.
